gaps.reason: No school-level Diploma XLSX newer than 2015/16 is on open.alberta.ca. The alberta.ca current-file URL returns 404. Per-school 2024/25 multiyear PDFs are embargoed for school-authority use until the embargo is lifted, so they are not used.
The 2024 Calgary Equity Index (i6pu-a35d) is a PDF/zip blob, not a community table. hy6b-89wc returns no rows.
Community Crime Statistics (78gh-n26t) requires a logged-in session. The open table 848s-4m4z ends in 2019 and its methodology was retired, so it is not shown as current safety.
CMHC publishes rent by zone only. There is no community-to-zone crosswalk, so a zone figure is not shown as a community figure.
Open Calgary has no 2021 census income-by-community table. The 2016 table (wj3a-wgmh) is too old to present as current.
Open Calgary has no 2021 census language-by-community table.
9qye-mibh is enrolment by grade through 2023-2024, not class size. The CBE 2025-26 enrolment report states it does not include class size.
CBE programs come from the public school-directory API (web/data/cbe_directory.json). CSSD programs, lottery-only flags, and overflow schools are still not included.
